facts.business: Akash Infra-Projects Limited is engaged in road construction projects.

auditor.name: A R P A N And Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters include: 1) Increase in revenue from operations due to higher execution of road construction projects with corresponding rise in cost of materials consumed. 2) Other Comprehensive Income includes Rs. 3.35 lakhs for remeasurement of net defined benefit gratuity obligation. 3) Trade receivables outstanding over 180 days aggregate to Rs. 143.99 Crores, major portion sub-judice. 4) Previous statutory auditor M/s. RRS & Associates resigned after carrying out unaudited limited review up to quarter ended September 30, 2025. 5) Company provided interest on unsecured loan at year-end only.

key_risks: Trade receivables outstanding for over 180 days aggregate to Rs. 143.99 Crores, major portion sub-judice
Previous statutory auditor resigned due to fee disagreement
Interest on unsecured loan provided only at year-end
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were on arms' length basis and in ordinary course of business. No materially significant related party transactions during the year. Policy available at www.akashinfra.com. Particulars in Form AOC-2 attached as Annexure-III.
